purpose: Records every job the clinic sends to a lab (prostheses, crowns, aligners, splints…) and shows which stage it is in, how many days it has been there and whether it is overdue, so no request gets lost and no fitting is booked before the job arrives.
tips: By default the list shows only pending orders (those that have not reached a final stage). Filters → Stage lets you pick "All" or a specific stage; if nothing is pending, "Show finished ones too" shows them.

An order is overdue when it has spent more days in its stage than that stage's limit, or when its due date has passed (from the next day) and it has not reached a final stage. In a final stage it is never overdue. Each reason is shown separately: the days in stage in red next to the stage limit (“5 days · max 3”) and the red “N days past due” tag. Pending orders without a lab carry the amber “No lab” tag.

The lab is chosen from the providers that belong to a laboratory category (provider groups marked as such). If the order’s services all share one category, the selector starts filtered by it. An order can be created without a lab, but to move it to a stage that is not final you must say which lab it is sent to.
Every stage change is recorded in the order history, with the user and the date.

The delivery date is asked for when the order is sent, that is, moved from the initial stage to a stage that isn't final, and it is required. It can be sent while creating it (“Send it now”, in the Review step) or later from the details. Afterwards it is changed from “Edit”.
On the board, drag a card to another column to change its stage; it saves on drop and, if saving fails, the card goes back. On a phone or with the keyboard use “Move to…” in the card menu.
Changes made by other users show up on their own, without reloading.
Turn on «Urgent» in the form so the order shows first in the list, in its board column and in the patient record; the Urgent button shows only those.

Creating an order goes step by step: Patient → Job → Laboratory → Review. When opened from the patient record or a clinical session, what is already filled in counts as done and it starts at the next step. “Edit” opens straight on Review.

While labs or lab jobs are missing, "Getting started" appears above the list: each step is done right there (add a lab with its specialties, turn on the services sent to a lab). Afterwards, the same options are under the "Set up" button.

When you send the order from the detail, the lab and the date are filled in the same panel, with no windows: the date is suggested from the stage deadline (shortcuts "In 3 days", "In 1 week", "In 2 weeks") and, if there is only one possible lab, it is already selected. Usually you just confirm.

The board loads each column in parts: about 20 cards first and, when you reach the end of the column’s scroll, the next ones. Sort by decides which cards go first. It applies the same filters as the list (patient and creation dates included), except the stage: each stage is a column.

lab-orders.btn.new.label: New order
lab-orders.btn.new.description: Opens the new order form. The order starts in the initial stage, without a delivery date: the date is asked for when it is sent to the lab.

lab-orders.section.filters.label: Search and filters
lab-orders.section.filters.description: Search by patient, job, lab or number; the quick buttons Overdue only, Urgent and Due today (with how many of each) and the Filters button with stage, lab, doctor, patient, created dates and sort order.

lab-orders.field.overdue-only.label: Overdue only
lab-orders.field.overdue-only.description: Shows only overdue orders: those that went over the days set for their current stage or are past their due date. Red when active.

lab-orders.section.detail-stage.label: Current stage
lab-orders.section.detail-stage.description: The stage the order is in, the days it has been there (red when over the limit) and the reason if it is overdue. Below, the progress through the stages and the buttons to move it.

lab-orders.btn.move-to.label: Other stage…
lab-orders.btn.move-to.description: Menu with every other stage, to skip stages, go back or close the order (for example, cancel it). It is recorded in the history. If the order has no lab and the stage is not final, it asks for the lab first.

lab-orders.section.history.label: History
lab-orders.section.history.description: The order timeline, newest first: each stage change (source, target, user, date and time, and how long it stayed in each stage, “Stayed 4 days”) and each edit (laboratory, doctor, expected delivery, urgent, services, description, notes) with the old and new value. At the top, the total time since it was created. The first one marks the current stage.

lab-orders.btn.edit.label: Edit
lab-orders.btn.edit.description: Changes the order details (not the stage).

lab-orders.btn.delete.label: Delete
lab-orders.btn.delete.description: Removes the order from the list and the board.

lab-orders.section.view.label: List or board
lab-orders.section.view.description: The list has every filter; the board shows one column per active stage, in the configured order.

lab-orders.section.board.label: Board
lab-orders.section.board.description: One column per stage. Cards show patient, job, lab (or "No lab"), due date ("N days past due" once it passes) and days in stage, in red when over the limit. Columns can be collapsed.

lab-orders.field.sort.label: Sort by
lab-orders.field.sort.description: Outside the filters: it applies to both the list and the board. On the board it decides which cards show first in each column (newest, oldest, most or fewest days in the stage). Pending urgent orders always go on top.

lab-orders.section.detail.label: Order detail
lab-orders.section.detail.description: Panel with the current stage, the progress, “Move to…” and “Other stage…”, the job, the order details, the notes and the history. From the header you can edit, delete, expand or close it.

lab-orders.btn.filters.label: Filters
lab-orders.btn.filters.description: Opens the rest of the filters. The number shows how many are applied.

lab-orders.section.services.label: Services
lab-orders.section.services.description: The work requested from the lab, picked from services flagged as “Lab work”. You can add several, each with its own quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.btn.add-service.label: Add service
lab-orders.btn.add-service.description: Finds a lab service and adds it to the order. If it does not exist you can create it here, and it is flagged as lab work.

lab-orders.btn.remove-service.label: Remove service
lab-orders.btn.remove-service.description: Removes that service from the order.

lab-orders.field.items.quantity.label: Quantity
lab-orders.field.items.quantity.description: Next to the service name, with − and +. Almost always 1: a 3-unit bridge is 1 job, which is why it is not calculated from the teeth.

lab-orders.field.items.teeth.label: Teeth
lab-orders.field.items.teeth.description: The teeth for that service. The order’s teeth are all its services’ teeth combined.

lab-orders.field.items.notes.label: Service note
lab-orders.field.items.notes.description: Instructions for that service only (shade, material…).

lab-orders.section.detail-services.label: Order services
lab-orders.section.detail-services.description: The requested services with quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.label: Laboratory
lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.description: Which lab the order is sent to. Optional when creating. If only one lab does those jobs, it comes preselected (can be removed). Filtered by specialty and, if missing, created right there.

lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.label: Send to the lab
lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.description: Window that opens when sending the order (from the detail, the board or the patient record) (moving it from the initial stage to a non-final one): the delivery date, required and already suggested, and the lab if it has none yet (in red while missing; preselected when only one is possible). It also appears when moving an order without a lab to a non-final stage. Moving to a final stage asks for nothing.

lab-orders.field.sent-on.label: When was it sent?
lab-orders.field.sent-on.description: When sending the order: today by default; Yesterday or Another day if it is recorded late. The order counts as sent on that day: days in stage, the suggested delivery and overdue status count from then, and the history also shows when it was recorded. It can't be in the future or before the order entered its current stage.

lab-orders.field.send-due-date.label: Delivery date
lab-orders.field.send-due-date.description: The date the lab promised. It is required and can't be earlier than the sending day; if the order already had one that hasn't passed, it comes filled in. If it was sent days ago the date may already have passed: the order becomes overdue. From the day after delivery, if the order hasn't reached a final stage, it becomes overdue.

lab-orders.section.detail-laboratory.label: Laboratory
lab-orders.section.detail-laboratory.description: The assigned lab with its categories and the details from its provider record: phones (you can dial them), email, address and RUT. If it has none, it says they are added in Purchases → Providers.

lab-orders.section.active-filters.label: Applied filters
lab-orders.section.active-filters.description: One chip per applied filter from the Filters button; the ✕ removes it and "Clear filters" removes them all. On the board, filters that do not apply there (stage, patient, dates) are dashed.

lab-orders.btn.open-patient.label: View patient
lab-orders.btn.open-patient.description: Opens the order’s patient file on top of the screen, without leaving lab orders.

lab-orders.btn.next-stage.label: Move to “next stage”
lab-orders.btn.next-stage.description: Moves the order to the next stage in the configured order with one click. Hidden once it is in a final stage. If it has no lab and the stage is not final, it asks for the lab first.

lab-orders.section.stage-progress.label: Progress
lab-orders.section.stage-progress.description: The stages of the workflow in order: past ones ticked, the current one highlighted and the remaining ones in grey.

lab-orders.section.detail-work.label: Job
lab-orders.section.detail-work.description: Requested services with quantity, teeth and note for each, or the job description when there are no services.

lab-orders.section.empty.label: No pending orders
lab-orders.section.empty.description: When there are no pending orders and no filters: New order button and "Show finished ones too".

lab-orders.field.urgent-only.label: Urgent
lab-orders.field.urgent-only.description: Shows only urgent orders that are still pending, in the list and on the board. Red when active.

lab-orders.toggle.urgent.label: Urgent
lab-orders.toggle.urgent.description: Marks the order as urgent (when creating or editing it). While pending it shows first with the red «Urgent» label; in a final stage it is no longer highlighted.

lab-orders.section.form-attachments.label: Attachments (new order)
lab-orders.section.form-attachments.description: Photos, PDFs or 3D scans (STL, PLY, OBJ) for the lab, up to 10 files of 10 MB. They are uploaded when the order is created; if they fail, the order is still created and they can be added from the details.

lab-orders.btn.add-attachment.label: Add files
lab-orders.btn.add-attachment.description: Chooses files to attach to the new order (they can also be dropped on the dashed area).

lab-orders.section.detail-attachments.label: Attachments
lab-orders.section.detail-attachments.description: The order files: download them with the arrow icon. With edit permission you can add more or remove them.

lab-orders.btn.upload-attachment.label: Add files
lab-orders.btn.upload-attachment.description: Uploads more files to the order from the details.

lab-orders.btn.remove-attachment.label: Remove
lab-orders.btn.remove-attachment.description: Deletes the attachment from the order (asks for confirmation; cannot be undone).

lab-orders.filter.search.label: Search
lab-orders.filter.search.description: Searches by patient, job, lab or order number.

lab-orders.btn.view-list.label: List
lab-orders.btn.view-list.description: Shows the orders in the table, with every filter.

lab-orders.btn.view-board.label: Board
lab-orders.btn.view-board.description: Shows one column per active stage; cards are dragged to change the stage.

lab-orders.section.first-row.label: First order
lab-orders.section.first-row.description: The first order in the list in the chosen sort order. Click to open its details.

lab-orders.section.row.label: Order
lab-orders.section.row.description: An order in the list. Click to open its details.

lab-orders.section.move-menu.label: Stages
lab-orders.section.move-menu.description: Every stage except the current one, in circuit order.

lab-orders.btn.move-option.label: Target stage
lab-orders.btn.move-option.description: Moves the order to that stage. A final stage asks nothing; a non-final one asks for the lab or due date if missing.

lab-orders.field.send-laboratory.label: Lab
lab-orders.field.send-laboratory.description: Which lab the order is sent to. Shown only if it has none yet.

lab-orders.btn.confirm-move.label: Confirm
lab-orders.btn.confirm-move.description: Moves the order to the chosen stage with the lab and due date entered.

lab-orders.field.patient_id.description: Patient the job is for. From the patient file it is already chosen.

lab-orders.field.doctor_id.description: Doctor who requested the job; the order’s alerts can go to them. If whoever creates the order is a doctor, they come preselected (can be changed).

lab-orders.field.work_description.description: Job description when there is no catalog service. Hidden when there are services: extra details go in Notes.

lab-orders.field.teeth.description: The order’s teeth when it has no services (comma-separated numbers).

lab-orders.field.due_date.description: Due date promised by the lab. Shown when editing an order that was already sent.

lab-orders.btn.submit.description: On the last step (Review): creates the order (or creates and sends it, if “Send it now” was chosen) or saves the changes.

lab-orders.btn.send.label: Send to the lab
lab-orders.btn.send.description: The next-stage button when the order leaves the initial stage or has no lab: shows, in the same panel, the lab and the delivery date to confirm.

lab-orders.section.wizard-steps.label: Order steps
lab-orders.section.wizard-steps.description: Patient → Job → Laboratory → Review. The current step is highlighted and completed ones show ✓. You can go back to any step; forward only if the previous ones are complete. Below, it says what is still missing to create it.

lab-orders.btn.step-patient.label: Patient step
lab-orders.btn.step-patient.description: Patient and the doctor requesting the job.

lab-orders.btn.step-work.label: Job step
lab-orders.btn.step-work.description: Lab services (with quantity, teeth and note) or, if it is not in the catalog, the job description.

lab-orders.btn.step-laboratory.label: Laboratory step
lab-orders.btn.step-laboratory.description: Which laboratory it goes to. Optional when creating it: it is asked for when the order is sent.

lab-orders.btn.step-review.label: Review step
lab-orders.btn.step-review.description: Summary with “Edit” per section, notes, attachments, urgent and whether to send it now.

lab-orders.btn.step-next.label: Continue
lab-orders.btn.step-next.description: Checks the step and moves to the next one. When editing, it goes back to Review.

lab-orders.section.wizard-summary.label: Summary
lab-orders.section.wizard-summary.description: What has been entered so far (patient, doctor, job, laboratory). Shown on wide screens.

lab-orders.section.lab-suggestions.label: Suggested laboratories
lab-orders.section.lab-suggestions.description: Laboratories to pick with one tap: those of the services’ category if there is only one, or the first ones on the list. For another one, the selector above searches or adds it.

lab-orders.btn.lab-later.label: Choose the laboratory later
lab-orders.btn.lab-later.description: Continues without a laboratory: the order is still created and the laboratory is asked for when it is sent.

lab-orders.section.review.label: Review
lab-orders.section.review.description: The order’s patient, job and laboratory; “Edit” goes back to that step.

lab-orders.field.send.label: What should happen to the order?
lab-orders.field.send.description: Save it in the initial stage to send later, or send it now to the next stage. Sending it requires the laboratory and the expected delivery date.

lab-orders.field.send_due_date.label: Expected delivery (when sent)
lab-orders.field.send_due_date.description: Date the laboratory promised; it cannot be earlier than today. From the next day the order shows as overdue.

lab-orders.field.due-today.label: Due today
lab-orders.field.due-today.description: Shows only pending orders whose delivery date is today: what should arrive from the lab today. The number is how many there are.

lab-orders.btn.show-all.label: Show finished ones too
lab-orders.btn.show-all.description: Sets the stage filter to "All" to also see completed or canceled orders.

lab-orders.section.due-shortcuts.label: Date shortcuts
lab-orders.section.due-shortcuts.description: "In 3 days", "In 1 week", "In 2 weeks" and the stage deadline: one tap fills in the delivery date. The highlighted one is the selected date.

lab-orders.section.setup.label: Getting started
lab-orders.section.setup.description: What is missing to use the module: labs and lab jobs, each with its button; the stages come ready. It disappears when everything is set.

lab-orders.btn.setup-laboratory.label: Add lab
lab-orders.btn.setup-laboratory.description: Opens the new lab form without leaving the module.

lab-orders.btn.setup-services.label: Choose jobs
lab-orders.btn.setup-services.description: Opens the list of services to mark which ones are sent to the lab.

lab-orders.btn.setup-stages.label: Review stages
lab-orders.btn.setup-stages.description: Goes to Lab stages to adjust the stages, deadlines and alerts.

lab-orders.btn.setup-menu.label: Set up
lab-orders.btn.setup-menu.description: Menu with Add lab, Lab jobs and Stages and alerts.

lab-orders.btn.menu-services.label: Lab jobs
lab-orders.btn.menu-services.description: Opens the list of services to mark which ones are sent to the lab.

lab-orders.section.new-laboratory.label: New lab
lab-orders.section.new-laboratory.description: Name, phone, email and what it does (specialties). Behind the scenes it creates the provider and assigns it to those specialties.

lab-orders.field.laboratory-name.label: Name
lab-orders.field.laboratory-name.description: Name of the lab, as shown on the orders.

lab-orders.field.laboratory-specialties.label: What it does
lab-orders.field.laboratory-specialties.description: Specialties of the lab (for example, Fixed prosthesis). At least one: that is what makes it a lab and lets it be suggested on orders for those jobs.

lab-orders.btn.new-specialty.label: New specialty
lab-orders.btn.new-specialty.description: Creates a specialty by typing its name (a provider group marked as a lab category).

lab-orders.field.new-specialty.label: Specialty name
lab-orders.field.new-specialty.description: Created with Enter or "Add", and it stays selected.

lab-orders.btn.save-laboratory.label: Save lab
lab-orders.btn.save-laboratory.description: Creates the lab. If the phone or email already belong to another contact, it warns first.

lab-orders.section.lab-services.label: Lab jobs
lab-orders.section.lab-services.description: The catalog services, lab ones first. Each has a switch that saves instantly and, when on, its specialty (optional).

lab-orders.filter.lab-services-search.label: Search service
lab-orders.filter.lab-services-search.description: Filters the list of services by name.

lab-orders.btn.new-lab-service.label: New lab work
lab-orders.btn.new-lab-service.description: Creates a service already marked as lab work, without going to Sales → Services. If the search finds nothing, it offers to create it with that name.

lab-orders.section.new-lab-service.label: New lab work
lab-orders.section.new-lab-service.description: The service basics: name, category, price and duration (in the clinic’s currency) and, if any, the specialty. The rest can be completed later in Sales → Services.

lab-orders.field.lab-service-name.label: Name
lab-orders.field.lab-service-name.description: What the work is called (e.g. Zirconia crown).

lab-orders.btn.save-lab-service.label: Create and mark
lab-orders.btn.save-lab-service.description: Creates the service and marks it as lab work; it shows at the top of the list.

lab-orders.toggle.lab-service.label: Lab work
lab-orders.toggle.lab-service.description: When on, the service can be requested on a lab order, and saving a session with it suggests the order. Saves instantly.

lab-orders.btn.lab-services-done.label: Done
lab-orders.btn.lab-services-done.description: Closes the list; the changes are already saved.

lab-orders.btn.teeth-picker.label: Tooth chart
lab-orders.btn.teeth-picker.description: Opens a small tooth chart to tap the teeth instead of typing them. It writes into the same field, with permanent or primary dentition.

lab-orders.section.teeth-picker.label: Pick teeth
lab-orders.section.teeth-picker.description: Quadrants as seen facing the patient. Tapping a tooth adds or removes it; “Clear” removes them all.
